3 tailored renewal email drafts (subject + body), grounded in team/playbooks/renewal-outreach.md and team/accounts/{acme-corp,brightline,corti-labs}.md. Ready for @reviewer QA before send. Drafts only — not sent.

=== 1. Acme Corp (Q3, $48k, High risk — re-sell) ===
Subject: Outcomes we delivered for Acme this year — and a proposal for the next 12 months

Hi [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: name of new economic buyer / successor stakeholder],

I'm reaching out because the champion who originally sponsored our work departed in May, and I want to make sure the value we've been delivering is still landing for your team. Rather than treat this as a renewal formality, I'd like to set up a short working session to walk through outcomes delivered to date vs. the goals you set for this term, and map what the next 12 months could look like.

Would you be open to a 30-minute re-introduction meeting next week? I'll bring a one-page recap of delivered value and a few questions to re-qualify fit against your current priorities.

No pricing discussion until we've aligned on whether the original use case still holds and a new sponsor is engaged.

Best,
[NEEDS CONFIRMATION: sender name/title]

[NEEDS CONFIRMATION: recipient email address]

=== 2. Brightline (Q3, $22k, Low risk — growth celebration + expansion) ===
Subject: Your usage is up 40% — let's lock in the renewal and talk expansion

Hi [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: renewal decision-maker],

Great news: your team's usage is up 40% this term. That growth is the strongest signal we could ask for, and I want to make sure we lock in the renewal with minimal friction, then explore whether additional seats or modules make sense given the trajectory.

Proposed: a standard-term renewal at $22k (no re-qualification needed given the adoption trend), plus a 20-minute follow-on to map expansion against the 40% growth. Can you confirm the decision-maker and signatory so we can move quickly?

Best,
[NEEDS CONFIRMATION: sender name/title]

[NEEDS CONFIRMATION: recipient email address]

=== 3. Corti Labs (Q4, $61k, Medium–High risk — accountability-first, held until escalations clear) ===
Subject: Open support escalations + Q4 renewal planning — owning this with you

Hi [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: account contact],

I want to acknowledge upfront that two support escalations remain open on your account. We own that, and I've assigned a named owner with a documented remediation plan and ETA for both: [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: owner name + ETA per escalation]. Before we open the Q4 renewal conversation, I want to confirm both are closed or have agreed remediation dates.

Once that's in place, I'd propose a Q4 business review that pairs escalation closure with forward-looking value planning for the $61k renewal term. This draft is held until the escalations clear; I'll follow up at that point.

Best,
[NEEDS CONFIRMATION: sender name/title]

[NEEDS CONFIRMATION: recipient email address]

=== Open [NEEDS CONFIRMATION] items ===
- Acme: new economic buyer / successor stakeholder name; recipient email; sender name/title.
- Brightline: renewal decision-maker + signatory; which features drove the 40% usage increase (for case-study reuse); recipient email; sender name/title.
- Corti Labs: status + owner for each of the two open escalations; internal SLA for closure ahead of Q4 window; recipient email; sender name/title.
